"""Record the actual draft materializations and both preapproval input sets."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64,datetime,gzip,hashlib,io,json,subprocess,tarfile
R=Path('/workspace/classical-ecdlp-validation-ready');F=Path('/workspace/classical-ecdlp-endpoint-reuse/fresh48-20261105-root');S=Path('/workspace/classical-ecdlp-endpoint-reuse/fresh48-20261105-design')
B='coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-e70832/batches/BATCH-9576ee/';tid='TASK-20261105-f8dce1'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
first=json.loads((F/'preapproval.stdout.txt').read_bytes());last=json.loads((F/'preapproval-corrected.stdout.txt').read_bytes())
assert first['approvable'] and last['approvable'] and not last['blockers']
for name in ['preapproval','preapproval-corrected']:
 c=json.loads((F/(name+'.json')).read_bytes());assert c['returncode']==0 and c['wait_returned']
packet=json.loads((S/'schema-correction/preapproval-packet.json').read_bytes())
for k,p in packet['preview'].items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==last['prospective_sha256'][k]
for row in json.loads((F/'preapproval-original-inputs/manifest.json').read_bytes()):assert row['matches_first_actual_preapproval'] and sha(Path(row['captured_path']).read_bytes())==first['prospective_sha256'][row['name']]
initial=json.loads((S/'draft-manifest.json').read_bytes());correction=json.loads((S/'schema-correction/manifest.json').read_bytes());draft_correction={r['path']:r for r in correction['changed_files_by_phase']['draft']['files']}
current=[]
for row in initial['draft_files']:
 row=draft_correction.get(row['path'],row);p=R/row['path'];raw=p.read_bytes();assert len(raw)==row['bytes'] and sha(raw)==row['sha256'];current.append(row)
claim=json.loads((R/(B+'claims/'+tid+'.1.claim.json')).read_bytes());assert claim['owner']=='coordinator-fresh48-materialization' and claim['epoch']==1
rows=[];files={}
for label,base in [('root',F),('design',S)]:
 for p in sorted(base.rglob('*')):
  assert not p.is_symlink()
  if not p.is_file() or (base==F and p.name=='prior-batch-tail.json'):continue
  # All completed design directories are immutable; actual approval is a later act.
  if base==S and ('actual-approval' in p.relative_to(base).parts or 'final-approval' in p.relative_to(base).parts):continue
  raw=p.read_bytes();rel=label+'/'+p.relative_to(base).as_posix();assert len(raw)<2<<20
  row={'path':rel,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw)};rows.append(row);files[rel]=raw
buf=io.BytesIO()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=buf,mode='w',format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as tf:
 for row in rows:
  ti=tarfile.TarInfo(row['path']);ti.size=row['bytes'];ti.mode=0o600;tf.addfile(ti,io.BytesIO(files[row['path']]))
rawtar=buf.getvalue();gz=gzip.compress(rawtar,compresslevel=9,mtime=0)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(gz)),mode='r:') as tf:
 assert tf.getnames()==[x['path'] for x in rows]
 for row in rows:assert tf.extractfile(row['path']).read()==files[row['path']]
elapsed=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(claim['acquired_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))).total_seconds()
record={'schema':'classical.ecdlp.design-materialization/v1','task_id':tid,'recorded_at':now(),'initial_draft_commit':'39e54c7cd7d60cb674735ad5b77aecedcfd71f98','corrected_draft_commit':'c4ecd2ccaf35e5325903660c9d7c5977cc87a0d9','scientific_curve_target_job_draws':0,'prospective_nonce_draws':1,'current_draft_files':current,'first_actual_preapproval':first,'corrected_actual_preapproval':last,'correction':'Only two required specification metadata fields and dependent hashes; earlier versions, full-ledger failure and both actual preapproval input sets retained. No protocol/source/config/workload/resource change.','budget':{'elapsed_from_native_claim_seconds':elapsed,'maximum_wall_seconds':900,'met_at_delivery':elapsed<=900},'capsule':{'format':'gzip+tar+base64','gzip_bytes':len(gz),'gzip_sha256':sha(gz),'tar_bytes':len(rawtar),'tar_sha256':sha(rawtar),'logical_bytes':sum(x['bytes'] for x in rows),'members':rows,'base64':base64.b64encode(gz).decode()},'scope':'Delivered exact draft and prospective input custody only. Official approval application, archive and all subsequent operations remain separate; no claim of scientific execution or mathematical conclusion.','source_utf8':Path(__file__).read_text()}
dest=R/(B+'design-materialization.json')
with dest.open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'path':str(dest),'bytes':dest.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(dest.read_bytes()),'capsule_members':len(rows),'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'budget_met':elapsed<=900}))
